g.text: PR #2225 · Supervise hosted services independently of agent sessions
Session-owned service processes can disappear on restart.
Launcher-owned recipes restore them while a stable relay preserves the URL.
BEFORE
AFTER
PluginProcess::spawn_surface
The command that opens the plugin spawns its server.
SurfaceState remembers a PID and a chosen port.
No persistent recovery loop
Session restart or server exit can leave no listener.
A saved process record does not restart the service.
Forward remains, hosted app disappears
Opening the plugin again is a manual recovery step.
Registering a different port rotates the forward URL.
plugin open / forward run
Persist Recipe: executable, arguments, cwd, environment.
The launcher owns it independently of the agent session.
managed_forward::supervise + serve
Restore recipes; restart exits and failed health checks.
PORTAL_PORT + {port} inject each child's allocated port.
Stable relay port, replaceable child
Child recovery retains the URL; occupied relays fail safely.
Revocation stops recovery; generations protect replacements.
Start commands must keep the server in the foreground.
Crash + restore + revocation tested with a real HTTP child.
Requires the updated launcher. Browser traffic still waits for the session tunnel to reconnect; this change does not deploy it.
